title: Whispered Dreams

outfit_card.silhouette: Airy A-line silhouette with a sheer, layered chiffon-overlay skirt, a fitted bodice with a draped off-shoulder neckline, and delicate trailing ribbon-like sleeve streamers; asymmetrical hem with translucent tulle panels adding ethereal volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A slender white feather and pearl hairpin with a tiny silver leaf, accompanied by a fine silver forehead chain with a teardrop gem.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A sheer mint-green chiffon bodice with a draped off-shoulder neckline, featuring a central embroidered leaf-and-vine motif in silver and pearl, a delicate metallic collar necklace with a teardrop pendant, and cascading ribbon streamers from the sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered skirt of translucent mint and ivory chiffon with a scalloped tulle hem, worn over a subtle petticoat, with fine silver lace-up gladiator sandals wrapping the ankles and calves.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating white butterflies, tiny glowing motes, and a translucent trailing ribbon attached to the back, plus scattered leaf and vine embroidery motifs.
